#!/bin/sh
set -u

base=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
pidfile=$base/run/worker.pid
lockfile=$base/run/control.lock
worker=$base/worker.py

read_pid() {
    pid=
    [ -f "$pidfile" ] || return 1
    IFS= read -r pid < "$pidfile" || :
    case "$pid" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) pid=; return 2 ;;
        *) return 0 ;;
    esac
}

is_worker() {
    check_pid=$1
    [ -n "$check_pid" ] || return 1
    [ -r "/proc/$check_pid/cmdline" ] || return 1
    tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$check_pid/cmdline" | grep -F -x -q "$worker"
}

classify_pidfile() {
    if ! read_pid; then
        if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
            pid_kind=stale
        else
            pid_kind=missing
        fi
    elif is_worker "$pid"; then
        pid_kind=live
    elif kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        pid_kind=foreign
    else
        pid_kind=stale
    fi
}

mkdir -p "$base/run"
exec 9>"$lockfile"
flock -x 9

case ${1-} in
    start)
        classify_pidfile
        case "$pid_kind" in
            live)
                printf 'worker already running (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
                exit 0
                ;;
            foreign)
                printf 'ignoring PID file for unrelated process %s\n' "$pid"
                ;;
            stale)
                printf 'removing stale PID file\n'
                ;;
        esac
        rm -f "$pidfile"
        python "$worker" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
        new_pid=$!
        if ! is_worker "$new_pid"; then
            wait "$new_pid" 2>/dev/null || :
            printf 'worker failed to start\n' >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        new_pidfile=$base/run/.worker.pid.$$
        trap 'rm -f "$new_pidfile"' 0 1 2 3 15
        printf '%s\n' "$new_pid" > "$new_pidfile"
        mv -f "$new_pidfile" "$pidfile"
        trap - 0 1 2 3 15
        printf 'worker started (pid %s)\n' "$new_pid"
        ;;
    stop)
        classify_pidfile
        case "$pid_kind" in
            missing)
                printf 'worker stopped (no PID file)\n'
                ;;
            stale)
                rm -f "$pidfile"
                printf 'removed stale PID file\n'
                ;;
            foreign)
                foreign_pid=$pid
                rm -f "$pidfile"
                printf 'removed PID file for unrelated process %s; process left running\n' "$foreign_pid"
                ;;
            live)
                worker_pid=$pid
                kill "$worker_pid"
                tries=0
                while is_worker "$worker_pid"; do
                    tries=$((tries + 1))
                    if [ "$tries" -ge 10 ]; then
                        kill -KILL "$worker_pid" 2>/dev/null || :
                        break
                    fi
                    sleep 1
                done
                rm -f "$pidfile"
                if is_worker "$worker_pid"; then
                    printf 'worker %s did not stop\n' "$worker_pid" >&2
                    exit 1
                fi
                printf 'worker stopped (pid %s)\n' "$worker_pid"
                ;;
        esac
        ;;
    status)
        classify_pidfile
        case "$pid_kind" in
            live)
                printf 'worker running (pid %s)\n' "$pid"
                exit 0
                ;;
            foreign)
                printf 'PID file belongs to unrelated process %s\n' "$pid"
                exit 1
                ;;
            stale)
                printf 'stale PID file\n'
                exit 1
                ;;
            missing)
                printf 'worker stopped (no PID file)\n'
                exit 3
                ;;
        esac
        ;;
    *)
        printf 'usage: %s {start|stop|status}\n' "$0" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
